text:
Mia Chen: dropping an alternate compact billing tile - goal is a dense card that still surfaces org context, top projects and a 3-row token snapshot. mock: https://figma.redwood/compact-grid-v3 :card_index:
Devon Patel: nice density. request: keep per-model USD visible without extra clicks. ops teams rely on that for quick triage
Raja Iyer: suggest microbars for recent days above each token row (mini sparkline), and a 3-row table: Model | Tokens | Cost. show "+N" overflow for more rows
Sasha L: scope toggle looks good but add a left-aligned chip showing active org/project so people don't lose place. maybe small avatar + slug
Olivia Park: a11y: micro text contrast and hover targets are too small. target WCAG AA (4.5:1) and 44x44px touch for icons
Mia Chen: will increase contrast, enlarge hit areas. propose invoice action be a subtle kebab with explicit "Download CSV" on desktop and icon+sr-only label on mobile
Eli (PM): prefer explicit label visible on hover for desktop and always visible in the kebab menu. add XLSX export as an option (customer ask)
Devon Patel: UX tradeoff: stacked area shows composition but is noisy in compact. microbars + hover breakdown keeps vertical height low
Raja Iyer: make date range sticky per user and don't reset when switching org/project. also allow quick-presets (30d, 90d, MTD) in the card
Sasha L: copy tweak: header -> "Usage & Token costs" instead of generic "Billing". clearer for first-time users
Olivia Park: aria labels: replace generic chart id with aria-label="30-day spend and token cost by model" and add aria-live region for updates after filtering
DesignBot: scan results: contrast 0.38 fail for grey microtext, interactive chips missing keyboard tabindex, kebab menu needs aria-haspopup and role="menu"
Eli (PM): priorities: 1) AAA? at least AA contrast for micro text 2) explicit invoice download affordance + filename pattern 3) date-range persistence. microbars and overflow modal next sprint
Mia Chen: filename pattern proposal: <org-slug>-invoice-YYYY-MM.csv (e.g., redwood-inc-invoice-2025-03.csv). will sync with backend for Content-Disposition
Raja Iyer: overflow modal for +N projects: lightweight sheet with search, focus trap, and clear close label. virtualize rows if >20
Devon Patel: perf note: microbars should be canvas-based for large project counts to avoid DOM bloat
Sasha L: accessibility checklist for modal: focus trap, restore focus, Escape closes, announcement via aria-live when content loads
Mia Chen: thanks all. I'll iterate the Figma with contrast fixes, breadcrumb chip, kebab invoice menu + filename, sticky date presets, and post new link here when ready :white_check_mark:
